description: Kaitlyn Becker was working on her doctorate at Harvard University when she helped develop a soft robotic system that can handle complex objects by using entanglement grasping. She joins to explain how creatures of the sea inspired the robotic gripper and how it might be used in the future.
classificationReason: Technical interview about a soft robotic gripper using entanglement grasping for complex objects.
qualityReason: Original researcher interview with substantive technical explanation.
